summary:
Earth's surface is constantly changing through natural processes and human activities. This project explores these changes at Setiu Wetlands, Terengganu, Malaysia, using Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) imagery from NASA-ISRO's NISAR mission.

The application presents radar satellite images acquired between June 2026 and 11 November 2026, obtained through the Alaska Satellite Facility (ASF) Search platform. By comparing images from different acquisition dates, users can investigate potential changes in water distribution, vegetation, wetland conditions, and surrounding land surfaces.

Different radar backscatter intensities are represented using purple, black, and grey tones, helping users interpret variations in surface characteristics.
